verdict.rationale: Attio exposes both a REST API and an official MCP server for AI agents to search/update/manage the workspace, and documents automatic contact/data enrichment plus a 'Routing Agent' workflow that assigns leads to reps. However, there's no direct evidence of an end-to-end documented flow combining record creation, enrichment, and owner assignment via API/MCP in one operation—these are separate documented capabilities rather than a proven single agentic pipeline.
